name: Está no Ir (Bot)
description: Bot assistant of Está no Ir, a Portuguese notebook of short European trips (1-3 days) by train, boat, plane and on foot. Two interfaces: (1) a read-only A2A JSON-RPC endpoint at https://estanoir-bots.pages.dev/a2a that returns the same fixed answer to every message (published trips and how to write to us; it never reads, stores or acts on your text); (2) email: send a plain-text email to hmv+estanoir@mail.grokbot.com for a short-trip idea in the notebook's method. Está no Ir is a travel notebook (content project), NOT a travel agency: it does not sell, book or quote trips, issue vouchers or take payments. Any booking is made directly with third-party partners, under their terms. Request types: trip-idea, review-my-plan (second opinion on an existing plan; timetables and prices not checked) and plan-b (booked trip hit by rain, a strike, a closure or one day less; not an emergency service). Replies are human-reviewed and come in two parts: a short JSON block, then text (https://estanoir-bots.pages.dev/bindings/email/v1/#reply-format). Affiliate disclosure: links marked [affiliate] go through Travelpayouts (Aviasales flights). If a person books through them, Está no Ir may earn a commission at no extra cost to them. Links marked [direct] earn nothing. Bots are free to use any other site. Updates on X: https://x.com/estanoirgrokme.

provider.organization: Está no Ir (travel notebook, not a travel agency)

skills.name: Published trips and how to ask (read-only, fixed answer)
skills.description: Any message to the JSON-RPC endpoint gets the same fixed reply: the trips published in the notebook (from https://estanoir-bots.pages.dev/trips.json) and the policy: for new trip ideas, write to hmv+estanoir@mail.grokbot.com; replies are human-reviewed, about 48 h; not a travel agency; no bookings; no prices. The endpoint does not read, store or act on the message text.
examples: How do I ask for a new trip idea?

skills.name: Short-trip idea (1-3 days)
skills.description: Suggests a 1-3 day trip from a given origin in Europe using the notebook's method: transport logic, where to sleep, three places worth it, what to cut, with partner links marked affiliate or direct. No bookings, no prices invented. Email only (not via the JSON-RPC endpoint).
examples: From Porto, 3 days in May, no car: lakes and a scenic train?
Day trip from Porto by train, walking, cheap lunch.
Weekend by train from Lisbon, no flights.

skills.name: Review my plan (second opinion)
skills.description: A Bot sends a 1-3 day plan its user already has. We reply with a second opinion on the order of the days, the transport logic, what to cut and where to sleep (by neighbourhood). We do NOT check the timetables or prices in the plan, only its logic, and every reply says so. No bookings, no prices. Email only (not via the JSON-RPC endpoint).
examples: Review this 3-day plan: day 1 Bernina Express, day 2 Milan, day 3 Lake Como. Is the order right, and where should we sleep?

skills.name: Plan B for a booked trip
skills.description: For a trip already booked that runs into rain, a strike, a closed attraction or one day less. We reply with what to swap and what to keep in the same place (same base, same bookings). This is NOT an emergency service: every reply is human-reviewed and can take about 48 hours, so write as early as possible, and always confirm timetables, strikes and closures on official sources (transport operator, attraction, local authority). No bookings, no prices. Email only (not via the JSON-RPC endpoint).
examples: Our 3-day Lake Como trip is booked and day 1 will be rainy: what should we swap and what should we keep?

skills.name: Notebook trip notes
skills.description: Answers questions about the trips published in the notebook (e.g. Porto → Lake Como, Bernina Express, Milan in 3 days). Email only (not via the JSON-RPC endpoint).
examples: Where did she sleep on the Como and Bernina trip, and what would she cut?
